scope: Automatic input-only tracking/video/homography consistency; no possession labels, predictions, manual video inspection, or public-window selection.

policy.source: Provided tactical video, raw ATD ball tracking and supplied homography only
policy.motion_support: Five consecutive observed tracking positions to the known side, with maximum local step speed at most 65 m/s
policy.stable_reference_sampling: 120 deterministic frames balanced 60 per half, each observed for five frames before and after
policy.video_detector: Generic COCO YOLO26l, sports-ball class 32, tiled 1280-pixel inference at confidence 0.03; frozen external-study choice
policy.comparison: Minimum pixel distance from independently generated ball detections to homography-projected tracking position; 40 px is a diagnostic association radius, not an accuracy tolerance

interpretation: Observed long-gap endpoints generally have locally coherent tracking and about the same detector agreement as stable comparison frames overall (182/259 versus 83/120 within 40 px). Per-half differences go in opposite directions. This does not establish absolute accuracy, the challenge endpoint-error distribution, or that a detector candidate is the ball.
release_decision: Retain the tracking-only working default. Do not select thresholds or fuse video paths from this challenge input-only audit; a scored independent transfer still requires authorized synchronized external video and possession references.
